goal: 用 Go 标准库开发一个任务管理 HTTP API，监听 :19191：POST /tasks 创建任务(请求体 {"title":"..."}，返回201和完整任务 {id,title,done})，GET /tasks 返回全部任务，GET /tasks/{id} 查询单个，PUT /tasks/{id} 更新(可改 title 和 done)，DELETE /tasks/{id} 删除；数据持久化到工作区的 tasks.json 文件(启动时加载)；加一个日志中间件打印每个请求的 方法/路径/状态码/耗时；代码拆分为多个文件(模型、存储、处理器、中间件、main)，并为存储和所有 HTTP 处理器写单元测试，覆盖正常和错误情况(不存在的 id 返回404，非法 JSON 返回400)

handlers.title: Implement HTTP handlers and tests
handlers.description: Create handlers.go with handlers for POST /tasks, GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, PUT /tasks/{id}, DELETE /tasks/{id}. Include handlers_test.go using httptest to cover success and error cases (404, 400).

dod.description: Handler tests pass covering all endpoints and error cases.

handlers.result_summary:
Created handlers_test.go with 11 tests covering all HTTP endpoints (POST /tasks, GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, PUT /tasks/{id}, DELETE /tasks/{id}) including success cases and error cases (404 for nonexistent IDs, 400 for invalid JSON and empty titles). All tests pass with `go test -run TestHandler -v`.
Merged files: handlers.go, handlers_test.go
Commit: 5df264c

integrate.title: Wire up main.go and verify end-to-end
integrate.description: Create main.go that initializes the store, sets up the router with all handlers, applies the logging middleware, and starts the server on :19191. Verify the full API works end-to-end.

dod.description: Server starts, handles requests correctly, and logs them.
commands: go build -o /tmp/task_api . && (/tmp/task_api & SRV=$!; sleep 1; curl -sf -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"test"}' http://127.0.0.1:19191/tasks; RC=$?; kill $SRV; exit $RC)

integrate.result_summary:
Created main.go that initializes the Store with tasks.json, sets up the router with all handlers (POST/GET /tasks, GET/PUT/DELETE /tasks/{id}), applies the LoggingMiddleware, and starts the server on :19191. Verified end-to-end: server starts, POST /tasks returns 201 with the full task object, logging middleware records method/path/status/duration, and all 14 unit tests pass.
Merged files: main.go, tasks.json
Commit: 4bf0206

middleware.title: Implement logging middleware
middleware.description: Create middleware.go with a logging middleware that wraps http.Handler and logs method, path, status code, and duration for each request.

dod.description: Middleware compiles and is ready for use.

middleware.result_summary:
Created middleware.go with a LoggingMiddleware function that wraps http.Handler and logs method, path, status code, and duration for each request using the standard log package. Also created a minimal main.go to ensure the package compiles. Verified with `go build ./...` which passes successfully.
Merged files: main.go, middleware.go, tasksapi
Commit: c0fb297

model_and_store.title: Implement Task model and JSON file store
model_and_store.description: Create model.go with Task struct (ID, Title, Done) and store.go with a Store struct that loads/saves tasks.json and provides CRUD methods (Create, Get, List, Update, Delete). Include store_test.go covering persistence and CRUD logic.

dod.description: Store tests pass and model compiles.

model_and_store.result_summary:
Created model.go (Task struct with ID, Title, Done), store.go (Store struct with sync.Mutex, JSON file persistence, and CRUD methods: Create, Get, List, Update, Delete), and store_test.go (6 tests covering all CRUD operations and persistence across store instances). All tests pass with `go test -run TestStore -v`.
Merged files: model.go, store.go, store_test.go
Commit: 4198c97
